articles.summary: Award-winning projects demonstrate complex modernization at two globally recognized destinations Elevator World magazine has selected two Otis Worldwide Corporation (NYSE: OTIS ) modernization projects as winners in its annual Project of the Year awards. Otis is the world's leading elevator and escalator manufacturing, installation, service and modernization company. Willis Tower in Chicago won in the Elevators Modernization category and Shanghai Science and Technology Museum received the honor in the Escalators Modernization category. The two very different modernization projects demonstrate the scale and range of Otis modernization expertise: one at a globally recognized supertall building and the other at a major public museum where mobility technology becomes an integral part of how people explore the building. articles.title: Otis Modernization Projects at Willis Tower and Shanghai Science Museum Win Elevator World Awards

articles.summary: Otis (NYSE: OTIS), the world's leading elevator and escalator manufacturing, installation, service and modernization company, now holds the official Guinness World Records™ title for "Tallest Elevator in a Building" for two Otis elevators at Tianjin 117 in Tianjin, China. Rising 597.2 meters, the two record-setting Otis SkyRise® elevators combine precision engineering and intelligent connectivity to deliver reliable and smooth experiences for visitors traveling to the building's observation deck. As the sole elevator and escalator provider for Tianjin 117, Otis is providing 266 units for the building, along with specialist field capabilities to support installation at record-breaking height. "Supertall buildings express what people can achieve through ambition, ingenuity and engineering, and they become defining features of the cities around them," said Judy Marks, Otis Chair, CEO President. articles.title: Otis Receives Guinness World Records™ Title for Tallest Elevator at Tianjin 117
